item.title: UAE: Fog set to blanket Abu Dhabi, Dubai as humidity soars; slight chance of rain by Tuesday
item.description: Residents across the UAE can expect misty mornings this weekend as humidity levels rise, leading to frequent fog formation. While Saturday brings fair to partly cloudy skies and a temperature drop, overnight humidity will increase, potentially reducing visibility for early commuters. Motorists are urged to drive with caution.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Why MAGA is blaming Blue state California for Jashanpreet Singh’s deadly truck crash that killed 3
item.description: A fatal truck crash in California, claiming three lives, has ignited a political firestorm. Federal officials are pointing fingers at the state for allegedly issuing a commercial driver's license to an undocumented immigrant, Jashanpreet Singh, despite federal restrictions. Investigations reveal systemic errors in California's licensing system, raising serious questions about public safety and immigration enforcement.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Streamer Hasan Piker urges viewers to focus on politicians’ actions, not their labels
item.description: Hasan Piker urged liberals and online leftists to critically evaluate politicians by focusing on their policies and track records, not just their branding or labels. He stressed the importance of analyzing real-world impacts to avoid being misled by appearances, citing Andrew Cuomo as an example. Piker's commentary encourages active scrutiny over passive consumption of political narratives.

item.title: Emman Atienza cause of death: How did the TikTok star and daughter of Kuya Kim Atienza die at 19
item.description: TikTok creator Emman Atienza, 19, daughter of TV host Kim Atienza, passed away by suicide in Los Angeles on October 22. Known for her honest discussions on self-love and mental health, her passing has deeply affected her family, friends, and thousands of young followers who found solace in her online presence.

item.title: Donald Trump’s son hits back at Chelsea Clinton over White House demolition: ‘Your parents stole furniture’
item.description: A political feud reignited between the Clinton and Trump families after Donald Trump Jr. responded to Chelsea Clinton's criticism of the East Wing demolition. Clinton accused President Trump of "erasing American heritage," while Trump Jr. referenced past Clinton controversies, including alleged White House furniture removal and the Monica Lewinsky scandal.

item.title: What will Donald Trump call his $250 million ballroom? Here’s what the US president said
item.description: President Trump is reportedly set to name the new White House ballroom, costing $300 million, after himself. Dubbed 'The President Donald J. Trump Ballroom,' the project, which replaced the East Wing, has raised over $350 million. Trump has pledged millions of his own funds for the expansive addition, aiming to leave a lasting legacy.

item.title: DNA from soldiers’ teeth reveals the secret that really killed Napoleon’s army
item.description: New DNA evidence from Napoleon's soldiers' teeth shows diseases like paratyphoid and relapsing fever were major killers during the Russian campaign. These invisible enemies weakened troops, contributing significantly to the army's catastrophic retreat. This discovery shifts historical understanding from solely blaming the cold to recognizing disease as a primary cause of the Grande Armée's downfall.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Why are fans posting mass RIP tributes for Ted Nivison on X? The truth behind whether he is dead or alive
item.description: YouTuber Ted Nivison trended on X with fake RIP messages. This was due to an old joke from 2022 resurfacing. His friend JSchlatt posted a tribute, sparking a viral meme. Nivison himself played along, confirming it was an inside joke. Fans reacted with humor and some concern over the spread of misinformation.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Pokémon VGC champion WolfeyGlick opens up about groping and online harassment
item.description: Pokémon VGC Champion Wolfe "WolfeyVGC" Glick has bravely shared his distressing experiences of harassment, including groping during fan interactions and unsolicited sexual comments online. These incidents have deeply affected his well-being, leading him to reconsider attending live competitive events. His disclosure highlights a critical need for enhanced safety measures at fan gatherings.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries throws weight behind Zohran Mamdani — Why it’s a big deal for Democrats and NYC politics
item.description: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has officially endorsed Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor, just weeks before the election. Despite "principled disagreements," Jeffries emphasized party unity against President Trump, highlighting Mamdani's focus on affordability and inclusivity. This endorsement comes as Republicans criticize Mamdani's socialist affiliation.

item.title: After daughter’s suicide, Virginia mother urges parents to keep phones out of children’s bedrooms
item.description: A Virginia mother is issuing a stark warning to parents after her 10-year-old daughter died by suicide, exacerbated by cyberbullying. The grieving mother believes her daughter's late-night smartphone use in bed played a critical role. Experts highlight the dangers of screens disrupting sleep and amplifying mental health issues, especially for vulnerable children.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai real estate giant DAMAC Properties enters Iraq with Phase One of their landmark project
item.description: Dubai's DAMAC Properties has launched its first project in Iraq, DAMAC Hills Baghdad, a luxury master community near the international airport. This expansion into Iraq, a key part of the company's regional growth strategy, aims to meet surging demand for upscale housing and supports Baghdad's urban redevelopment plans.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Palestinian refugee rants against ‘white people’ over gory Halloween decorations in Canada: 'What's fun about...'
item.description: A Palestinian refugee in Montreal sparked controversy by ranting against "white people" over Halloween decorations, calling them "uncivilized." The activist, known for her pro-Palestine stance, faced backlash for disrespecting her host country's traditions and values, despite doubling down on her comments.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Abu Dhabi rolls out variable speed limits on Sheikh Zayed Road: What motorists must know about the new system
item.description: Abu Dhabi is rolling out a dynamic speed limit system on Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Road from October 27, 2025. This initiative will allow real-time adjustments to speed limits based on weather, traffic, events, or roadworks, aiming to boost safety and ease congestion. Motorists are urged to adhere to the digital signs for smoother journeys.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE Hajj pilgrimage 1447H / 2026 health requirements: Find out who can perform Hajj next year
item.description: Ahead of the 2026 Hajj season, Saudi Arabia and the UAE have implemented strict new health regulations. Emirati pilgrims must now pass comprehensive medical exams, barring those with chronic or debilitating conditions. This ensures a safe and sustainable pilgrimage, with thousands still applying despite the tighter requirements.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Emirates Loves India: Registration, lineup, and full visitor guide to Dubai’s biggest Indian community event of 2025
item.description: Dubai gears up for "Emirates Loves India" on October 26, 2025, at Zabeel Park, celebrating Indian heritage and UAE-India ties. This free event, expecting over 70,000 attendees, features star performances, a cultural parade, diverse food stalls, and a dedicated kids' zone, highlighting the community's contributions.
